notes: The declared set compiles into a 36-member wasm32 relocatable archive: 34 retained upstream translation units, one project call-frame adapter, and the required empty Zig root object.
archive_built_unlinked means standard relocatable objects exist; generated functions, kernel-backed protected-call hooks, libc, the AgentOS adapter, and the runner are separate final-link inputs.

The project adapter owns the versioned strict-AOT program metadata, frame entry, fixed and open-result return, variadic frame preparation and retrieval, zero-upvalue, one-direct-value-upvalue, and one-reference-upvalue closure materialization, open/closed UpVal access and mutation, fixed and open-argument/result compiled calls, a GC-rooted static-module registry that caches successful exports, retries failed initializers, explicitly rejects active cycles, and caches the entry-module result, plus the Proto teardown ABI.
lvmutils.cpp remains because it owns reusable value, table, comparison, arithmetic, concatenation, length, loop, and metamethod helpers.

luaV_getimport remains trapped in forbidden VM/src/lvmload.cpp and general imports remain unsupported; exact safe-environment-proven literal require clusters are instead resolved to closed-package module IDs and call mc_luau_aot_v1_require_static.
